title: Detailed light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffde0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffe95c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffc21a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glass' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffbe0' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft outer halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='40' fill='#ffd94a' opacity='0.18'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='32' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.22'/>

  <!-- glass bulb -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='26' fill='url(#glow)' stroke='#ff9f1a' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- inner glass highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='31' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.65' transform='rotate(-25 41 31)'/>

  <!-- inner coiled filament wires -->
  <path d='M42 58 C42 50 38 48 44 45 C50 42 56 42 62 45 C58 48 54 50 54 58'
        fill='none' stroke='#ff6a00' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- glowing filament core -->
  <path d='M45 55 C45 50 47 49 50 49 C53 49 55 50 55 55'
        fill='none' stroke='#fff6b0' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='49' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- small support wires -->
  <line x1='44' y1='49' x2='42' y2='57' stroke='#e07b00' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='49' x2='58' y2='57' stroke='#e07b00' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- neck collar of glass -->
  <path d='M42 64 Q50 68 58 64 L57 69 Q50 72 43 69 Z' fill='#ffe066' stroke='#ff9f1a' stroke-width='1.6'/>

  <!-- screw base (metal) -->
  <rect x='42' y='70' width='16' height='4' rx='1.6' fill='#c9c9d6' stroke='#9a9ab0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <rect x='42.5' y='74.5' width='15' height='3.6' rx='1.6' fill='#b5b5c6' stroke='#8f8fa6' stroke-width='1.1'/>
  <rect x='43' y='78.5' width='14' height='3.6' rx='1.6' fill='#c9c9d6' stroke='#9a9ab0' stroke-width='1.1'/>
  <rect x='43.5' y='82.5' width='13' height='3.4' rx='1.6' fill='#b5b5c6' stroke='#8f8fa6' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- bottom contact tip -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88.5' rx='4.5' ry='3.4' fill='#8f8fa6' stroke='#6f6f85' stroke-width='1.1'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#e0e0ea'/>

  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <path d='M25 24 l1.6 3.4 3.4 1.6 -3.4 1.6 -1.6 3.4 -1.6 -3.4 -3.4 -1.6 3.4 -1.6 z' fill='#fff7c2'/>
  <path d='M76 20 l1.2 2.6 2.6 1.2 -2.6 1.2 -1.2 2.6 -1.2 -2.6 -2.6 -1.2 2.6 -1.2 z' fill='#fff7c2'/>
</svg>
